name: Control Module Extension
title: Control Module Extension
subtitle: Kerbal Controller Mk1 · Main enclosure
revisions: Supersedes the V2.0 drawings; redrawn in the KC drawing frame

rows.label: Interboard connector from the Control Module (CN1)
Fan header (CN3): PWM only, no tach

layers.name: Top Layer
notes: All connectors are on this side; the GND pour fills the open area.

layers.name: Bottom Layer
notes: The V_12 pour carries the 12 V feed from CN1 to CN2, CN3, CN4 and CN5.

fab_notes: 1. Material: FR-4, 1.6 mm, 2 layers, JLCPCB standard (sheet 2 table).
2. Copper: 1 oz both sides. Surface finish: lead-free HASL.
3. Solder mask green, silkscreen white, both sides. Vias tented.
4. Fabricate to IPC-6012 Class 2. Electrical test 100 %.
5. Dimensions in mm. Tolerances unless noted: outline ±0.2, finished holes ±0.08.
6. Fabricate from the Gerber and drill files of the same revision as this drawing.
7. Minimum trace width 0.20 mm. Smallest hole Ø0.30 (vias) on Ø0.61 pads: 0.15 mm annular ring.
8. The 4 plated mounting holes (M1–M4) are not connected to any net; keep them isolated on both layers.
9. No controlled impedance, slots, castellations, edge plating or gold fingers.
bom_notes: 1. INSTALLED BY: JLCPCB = fitted by the JLCPCB assemblers (SMT and through-hole) before delivery; After delivery = fitted by the builder.
2. PROCESS gives the assembly process and the side the part is on.
3. The board is passive: connectors only, every signal passes straight through.
4. Substitutes need the approval of the design authority.
place_notes: 1. All parts are through-hole on the top side. The board is shown in two overlapping parts.
2. Red dot = pin 1 of every connector. These match the silkscreen marks.
3. CN3 (fan) is pin 1 FAN_PWM, pin 2 not connected, pin 3 V_12, pin 4 GND.
4. CN2 terminal order differs from the GX16-10 pin order from pin 5 on; wire the harness by signal name (Hardware Reference §10.4). The silkscreen marks V_12 as VCC.
5. Part centres, rotations and part numbers are in the placement table (last sheet), measured from the datum (top view).
